content:
Alex K: Heads-up — Helios Pharm CTO asked for crisp answers before the exec touchpoint: egress/end-to-end SSO, committed pricing tiers for pilot scale, and a latency/throughput profile for their 100–500 concurrent-agent POC. Touchpoint in ~3h. Can we triage blockers?
Maria (sales): On it. Need the pricing delta for 100k vs 1M vs 10M tokens/day so I can propose a trial tier. Also: can we confirm seat-based vs usage pricing for this pilot?
Sanjay: I can run perf runs on a dedicated pool this afternoon. Plan: run concurrency sweeps (50 / 200 / 500) on dedicated-2 (nv24). Will post summarized p50/p95/p99.
Lisa (security): CTO attached a short questionnaire (KMS, VPC peering, retention, SOC2 scoping). I flagged 4 Qs as blockers. Link to doc: https://redwood.internal/sec/helios-q1. I'll draft answers but need product signoff on data retention policy.
Jordan (CS): I have their POC checklist and the runbook. Noting they require SAML SSO via Okta + SCIM provisioning. I'll validate SSO handshake.
ops-bot: perf-test submitted by Sanjay — job 9832 queued on dedicated-2. ETA ~18m.
Sanjay: Quick interim numbers from small run: 50c -> p50 95ms / p95 210ms. 200c test still running. Will attach CSV when done. Raw logs: s3://redwood-tests/9832/results.log
Alex K: Maria — can we offer a trial discount to reduce friction? If yes, what threshold triggers finance/exec approval?
Maria (sales): We can approve up to 20% promotional credit for a short pilot if they commit to a 6mo reserved capacity conversion. Anything >20% requires RevOps + CRO approval.
Lisa (security): On KMS BYO: we support customer KMS for key wrapping; needs KMS provisioning doc + IAM role. I'll put a templated snippet into the questionnaire response.
Jordan (CS): SSO sanity check command (will run and report):
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://poc.internal.redwood/auth/saml/check
```
Sanjay: 200c results: p50 210ms, p95 520ms, p99 1.2s. 500c ramping now — if we hit >1.5s p95 we should consider autoscale + model variant that uses kv-cache pruning.
Alex K: Good note. I'll prepare a one-slide exec summary: ask = trial discount + SSO/KMS checklist completed + capacity SLA (500c sustained for 30m). If security says QA is clean, we push to CTO.
Lisa (security): Draft answers are up at https://redwood.internal/sec/helios-q1-draft — ping me for edits.
Maria (sales): I'll scope a simple pricing table for the slide. Also looping RevOps if variance >20%.
Jordan (CS): Can someone confirm which model family we're serving for the POC? Latency numbers assume rdx-13b-q4. If they want rdx-70b, numbers change.
Sanjay: Confirmed: rdx-13b-q4 for initial run. If they request 70b, we need different sizing and pricing.
Alex K: Let's meet 14:45 PT (15m) to finalize the slide and questionnaire answers before the 15:00 CTO touchpoint. Can everyone make it? :thumbsup:
Maria (sales): I can.
Sanjay: yes, will upload CSV and attach perf graphs before the sync.
Lisa (security): I'll join and bring the KMS + retention answers.
Jordan (CS): I'll bring SSO logs and a short runbook excerpt.
ops-bot: reminder: calendar invite created for 14:45 PT.
Alex K: Thanks — this is on the hotlist. After the sync I will post the exec slide and next steps.
